relationships.subject: GRID1
relationships.evidence_quote: This effect may be attributable to the direct interaction of GRID1 with mediators of autophagy, such as neuronal (n)GOPC/nPIST, BECN1 and LAMP1.

relationships.subject: GRID1
relationships.evidence_quote: Using a GRID1 C-terminal-derived peptide (Tat-HRSPN), we demonstrate that GRID1 directly facilitates autophagy and subsequently reduces AMPAR expression in normal animals.

key_findings: GRID1/CBLN1 downregulation in CeA during pain accompanies impaired autophagic flux and increased AMPAR expression.
GRID1 C-terminal peptide shows GRID1 directly facilitates autophagy and reduces AMPAR expression.
